iecc.amendments: 2025 Energy Conservation Construction Code of New York State

plumbing.name: 2025 Residential Code of New York State Part VII Plumbing (Chapters 25-33, derived from 2024 IRC); 2025 Plumbing Code of NYS (2024 IPC base) for other buildings

elsewhere: NYS Uniform Code applies statewide except New York City, which has its own construction codes. Frost depth, snow and wind in Table R301.2 are filled in by each municipality.
notes: No tracked-number amendments found in the RCNYS preface (text of R309-R311 not retrievable). NY keeps its own smoke/CO alarm sections R310/R311.
